transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you could make it in today. What brings you in to see me?

Hi. Well, I came in because... I just barely care about the things that used to make me feel like myself anymore. Um, things like dance class, hiking, trying new recipes... even game night. They all just kind of sit there now. It feels like they're just chores that I keep putting off.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
Well, it's been going on since... since the robbery at that festival job I had. That was about two years and three months ago.
Since that happened, do you find yourself having unwanted memories, flashbacks, or nightmares about the robbery?

Yeah, I do get those. Um... sometimes it's just a specific sound, like a cash box snapping shut, or even just somebody coming up behind me in a kitchen. It brings the whole robbery back so fast. I can actually hear the voices again, and my stomach just drops... it feels like it is happening right then in that exact moment.
Do you find yourself actively avoiding places, people, or activities that remind you of the robbery?

Yeah, I do. I actually go out of my way to turn down any festival jobs now, or... or evening deliveries. Even certain shared kitchens, I just avoid them completely. I just really don't want to think about that night, and I know if I go near those places or do those things, I'll start to feel that panic start up again. So it's just easier to stay away.
Since the robbery, have you felt constantly on guard, jumpy, or easily startled by everyday things?

Yeah, I do. I'm just always on guard now. Like, if I'm in a parking lot or... or at a pickup, I'm constantly checking to see who is near me. I always make sure I know exactly where my car is and figure out how fast I could leave if I had to. It's just this feeling of needing to be ready, even if everyone else around me seems totally relaxed and fine.
